This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.591/2022 dated 24.12.2022 registered at Police Station- Baldevgarh, District- Tikamgarh, for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366,

The applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.

He submits that investigation is Rajkumar Sahani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162393525/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that the applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial as well as investigation and would make himself available as and when required.
Trial will take considerable time to conclude.
Upon these submissions, learned counsel prays that the applicant may be released on bail.
On the contrary, learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State opposes the bail application and submits that FSL report is positive.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.
According to the prosecution case, the prosecutrix was aged around 16 years 11 months at the time of incident.
In the statements recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the prosecutrix has narrated a consensual relationship with the applicant.

Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it appropriate to release the applicant on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of the trial.

It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE Prachi Rajkumar Sahani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162393525/
